reason: MCP Lens is an orchestration plugin that reduces large MCP catalogs to search and call interfaces, retrieves selected tool schemas, and routes permitted calls to configured MCP servers.

summaries.zh: MCP Lens 通过搜索大型 MCP 工具目录并按允许规则调用选定工具，帮助 DeepSeek Harness 管理多服务器和长尾工具。
summaries.en: MCP Lens helps DeepSeek Harness manage large MCP catalogs by searching for relevant tools, exposing selected schemas, and routing permitted calls to configured MCP servers.

capabilities: Retrieves exact schemas for selected MCP tools
Invokes configured remote MCP tools through mcp_call
Supports allow and deny patterns for tool exposure
Maintains a local catalog cache and supports lazy server connections
Provides a local calculator for measuring tool-schema size
